mapper.select: select fzp.JGFZID as ZZFBDM,fzp.FZMC as ZZFBMC,count(1) as FBSL,fzp.ORDERBY from DJZZRS_JGFZ fzp left join DJZZRS_JGFZ fz on fzp.JGFZID = fz.FJGFZID left join DJZZRS_FZJGGL zzfz on (fz.JGFZID = zzfz.JGFZID or fzp.JGFZID = zzfz.JGFZID) left join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on zzfz.DZZBM = zz.DZZDM where fzp.FJGFZID is null group by fzp.JGFZID,fzp.FZMC,fzp.ORDERBY order by ORDERBY

select sum(case when fb.ZZLB in ('100', '200', '300', '400') then 1 else 0 end) as DZZSL,-- 党组织总数 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '400' then 1 else 0 end) as DZBSL, -- 党支部数量 sum(us.USCOUNT) as DYSL -- 党员数量 from ZZ_ZZQKXX zz inner join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on zz.DZZDM = fb.DZZDM
inner join ( select distinct zzdw.DZZDM from ZZ_DWXX zzdw inner join LZ_DWJBXX dw on zzdw.DWBSM = dw.FDWBSM where 1=1 and dw.PROVINCE = #{province} ) t on zz.DZZDM = t.DZZDM
left join ( select us.SZDZBDM,count(1) as USCOUNT from VM_RYJBXX us inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX uz on us.SZDZBDM = uz.DZZDM
inner join ( select distinct zzdw.DZZDM from ZZ_DWXX zzdw inner join LZ_DWJBXX dw on zzdw.DWBSM = dw.FDWBSM where 1=1 and dw.PROVINCE = #{province} ) ut on uz.DZZDM = ut.DZZDM
where 1=1 and uz.DZZDM like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%') group by us.SZDZBDM ) us on zz.DZZDM=us.SZDZBDM where 1=1 and zz.DZZDM like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%')

select sum(case when fb.ZZLB in ('100', '200', '300', '400') then 1 else 0 end) as DZZZS,-- 党组织总数 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '100' then 1 else 0 end) as DWSL,-- 党委数量 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '100' and length(zz.DZZDM) = 12 then 1 else 0 end) as YJDWSL,-- 一级党委 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '100' and length(zz.DZZDM) = 15 then 1 else 0 end) as EJDWSL,-- 二级党委 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '200' then 1 else 0 end) as DGWSL,-- 党工委数量 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '300' then 1 else 0 end) as DZZSL, -- 党总支数量 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '400' then 1 else 0 end) as DZBSL, -- 党支部数量 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '300' and fzp.FZMC is not null then 1 else 0 end) as DZZSL_YSZD,-- 党总支-运输站段数量 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '400' and fzp.FZMC is not null then 1 else 0 end) as DZBSL_YSZD, -- 党支部-运输站段数量 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '400' and fb.JCZZFL='200' then 1 else 0 end) as DZBSL_YX, -- 党支部-院系 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '400' and fb.JCZZFL='300' then 1 else 0 end) as DZBSL_ZH, -- 党支部-综合 sum(case when fb.ZZLB = '400' and fb.JCZZFL='400' then 1 else 0 end) as DZBSL_LTX -- 党支部-离退休 from ZZ_ZZQKXX zz inner join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on zz.DZZDM = fb.DZZDM left join DJZZRS_FZJGGL zzfz on SUBSTR(zz.DZZDM, 1, 12) = zzfz.DZZBM and zzfz.JGFZID is not null left join DJZZRS_JGFZ fz on zzfz.JGFZID = fz.JGFZID left join DJZZRS_JGFZ fzp on fz.FJGFZID = fzp.JGFZID and fzp.FZMC = '运输站段' where 1=1 and zz.DZZDM like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%')

select (case t1.USERTYPE when 1 then '党员总数' when 2 then '停职党员数' when 3 then '在职党员' when 4 then '离退休' when 5 then '其他' when 6 then '正式党员' when 7 then '预备党员' when 8 then '入党申请人数' when 9 then '入党积极分子' when 10 then '发展对象' else '' end) USERTYPENAME, Coalesce(t2.NUM,t3.NUM,t4.NUM,t5.NUM,0) NUM from (select dic.DICKEY as USERTYPE from cf_dictionary dic where dic.DICTYPEKEY='monthType' and dic.DICKEY <= 10 ) t1 /*党员总数*/ left join (select 1 USERTYPE, count(*) num from ZZ_RYJBXX where 1=1 and SZDZBDM like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%')) t2 on t1.USERTYPE=t2.USERTYPE -- 党员总数 /*离退休 其他*/ left join ( select USERTYPE,count(*) NUM from ( select (case when gzgw.HZMC in('离退休人员','离休干部') then 4 else 5 end) USERTYPE from ZZ_RYJBXX us left join zzzd_gzgw gzgw on us.GZGW=gzgw.BM where 1=1 and us.SZDZBDM like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%') ) tt1 group by USERTYPE ) t3 on t1.USERTYPE=t3.USERTYPE /*正式党员 预备党员 入党申请人数 入党积极分子 发展对象*/ left join( select USERTYPE,count(*) NUM from ( select (case when ryzt.HZMC ='正式党员' then 6 when ryzt.HZMC ='预备党员' then 7 when ryzt.HZMC ='申请入党人' then 8 when ryzt.HZMC ='入党积极分子' then 9 when ryzt.HZMC ='发展对象' then 10 else 999 end) USERTYPE from ZZ_RYJBXX us left join zzzd_ryzt ryzt on us.RYZT=ryzt.BM where 1=1 and us.SZDZBDM like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%') ) tt2 group by USERTYPE ) t4 on t1.USERTYPE=t4.USERTYPE /*在职党员*/ left join ( select 3 USERTYPE,count(*) NUM from ( select distinct us.RYBM from ZZ_RYJBXX us left join gg_zgjbxx info on us.RYBM = info.RYBM left join zd_rylb rylb on info.RYLB = rylb.BM where 1=1 and us.SZDZBDM like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%') and rylb.BM like concat('1%') and length(rylb.BM)=3 ) tt3 ) t5 on t1.USERTYPE=t5.USERTYPE
order by t1.USERTYPE

select t1.SEXTYPE ,(case t1.SEXTYPE when 1 then '男' when 2 then '女' else '' end) SEXNAME ,ifnull(t2.NUM,0) NUM from (select dic.DICKEY as SEXTYPE from cf_dictionary dic where dic.DICTYPEKEY='monthType' and dic.DICKEY <= 2) t1 left join (select SEXTYPE,count(*) NUM from ( select distinct us.RYJBXXBS,us.RYBM,us.XB SEXTYPE from VM_RYJBXX us inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on us.SZDZBDM = zz.DZZDM where 1=1 and us.szdzbdm like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%')
and us.SZDZBDM like concat('',#{dzzdm},'%')
and us.ZWMC like '%党委书记%'
and us.ZWMC like '%党委副书记%'
and (us.ZWMC like '%支部书记%' or us.ZWMC like '%总支书记%')
and (us.ZWMC like '%支部副书记%' or us.ZWMC like '%总支副书记%')
and (us.GZGW not in('0500','0501','0502','0504') or us.GZGW is null)-- 在岗人员
) tt1 group by SEXTYPE ) t2 on t1.SEXTYPE=t2.SEXTYPE order by t1.SEXTYPE

select t1.AGETYPE ,(case t1.AGETYPE when 1 then '21-30' when 2 then '31-40' when 3 then '41-50' when 4 then '51以上' else '' end) AGENAME ,ifnull(t2.num,0) NUM from (select dic.DICKEY as AGETYPE from cf_dictionary dic where dic.DICTYPEKEY='monthType' and dic.DICKEY <= 4) t1 left join (select AGETYPE,count(*) num from ( select distinct RYBM, (case when AGE>=21 and AGE <= 30 then 1 when AGE>=31 and AGE <= 40 then 2 when AGE>=41 and AGE <= 50 then 3 when AGE>=51 then 4 else 5 end) AGETYPE from ( select distinct us.RYJBXXBS,us.RYBM,fb.NL AS AGE from VM_RYJBXX us inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on us.SZDZBDM = zz.DZZDM inner join RS_RYJBXXFB fb on us.RYBM = fb.RYBM where 1=1 and us.SZDZBDM like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%')
and us.SZDZBDM like concat('',#{dzzdm},'%')
and us.ZWMC like '%党委书记%'
and us.ZWMC like '%党委副书记%'
and (us.ZWMC like '%支部书记%' or us.ZWMC like '%总支书记%')
and (us.ZWMC like '%支部副书记%' or us.ZWMC like '%总支副书记%')
and (us.GZGW not in('0500','0501','0502','0504') or us.GZGW is null)-- 在岗人员
) tt1 ) tt2 group by AGETYPE ) t2 on t1.AGETYPE=t2.AGETYPE order by t1.AGETYPE

select t1.AGETYPE ,(case t1.AGETYPE when 1 then '5年以下' when 2 then '5-10年' when 3 then '10-15年' when 4 then '15年以上' else '' end) AGENAME ,ifnull(t2.num,0) NUM from (select dic.DICKEY as AGETYPE from cf_dictionary dic where dic.DICTYPEKEY='monthType' and dic.DICKEY <= 4) t1 left join (select AGETYPE,count(*) num from ( select distinct RYBM, (case when age < 5 then 1 when age>=5 and age < 10 then 2 when age>=10 and age < 15 then 3 when age>=15 then 4 else 5 end) ageType from ( select distinct us.RYJBXXBS,us.RYBM,(date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m%d') - us.sqrdrq) /10000 AS age from VM_RYJBXX us inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on us.SZDZBDM = zz.DZZDM where 1=1 and us.SZDZBDM like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%')
and us.SZDZBDM like concat('',#{dzzdm},'%')
and us.ZWMC like '%党委书记%'
and us.ZWMC like '%党委副书记%'
and (us.ZWMC like '%支部书记%' or us.ZWMC like '%总支书记%')
and (us.ZWMC like '%支部副书记%' or us.ZWMC like '%总支副书记%')
and (us.GZGW not in('0500','0501','0502','0504') or us.GZGW is null)-- 在岗人员
) tt1 ) tt2 group by AGETYPE ) t2 on t1.AGETYPE=t2.AGETYPE order by t1.AGETYPE

select d.HZMC,d.BM,ifnull(u.num,0) PGCOUNT from zzzd_ryzt d left join ( select ut.RYZT,count(*) num from ( select distinct us.RYBM,us.RYZT from VM_RYJBXX us inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on us.SZDZBDM = zz.DZZDM inner join zzzd_ryzt d on us.RYZT=d.BM where 1=1 -- t.RYZT in (2,3)
and t.SZDZBDM like concat('',#{partyGroup},'%')
and (us.GZGW not in('0500','0501','0502','0504') or us.GZGW is null)-- 在岗人员
) ut group by ut.RYZT ) u on d.BM=u.RYZT order by d.BM

select t1.EDUCATIONTYPE ,(case t1.EDUCATIONTYPE when 1 then '研究生' when 2 then '大学本科' when 3 then '大学专科' when 4 then '中专' when 5 then '高中、中技' when 6 then '其他' else '' end) EDUCATIONNAME ,ifnull(t2.num,0) NUM from (select dic.DICKEY as EDUCATIONTYPE from cf_dictionary dic where dic.DICTYPEKEY='monthType' and dic.DICKEY <= 6) t1 left join (select EDUCATIONTYPE,count(*) num from ( select distinct us.RYBM,us.SZDZBDM, (case when xl.HZMC in('研究生教育','博士研究生','硕士研究生','中央党校在职研究生','省（区、市）委党校在职研究生','研究生其他','研究生班') then 1 when xl.HZMC in('本科教育','大学本科') then 2 when xl.HZMC in('专科教育','大学专科') then 3 when xl.HZMC in('中等职业教育','中专') then 4 when xl.HZMC in('技校','高中及以下','高中') then 5 else 6 end) EDUCATIONTYPE from VM_RYJBXX us inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on us.SZDZBDM = zz.DZZDM left join zd_whcddm1 xl on us.XL=xl.BM -- 学历 where 1=1
and us.SZDZBDM like concat('',#{dzzdm},'%')
and us.ZWMC like '%党委书记%'
and us.ZWMC like '%党委副书记%'
and (us.ZWMC like '%支部书记%' or us.ZWMC like '%总支书记%')
and (us.ZWMC like '%支部副书记%' or us.ZWMC like '%总支副书记%')
and (us.GZGW not in('0500','0501','0502','0504') or us.GZGW is null)-- 在岗人员
) tt1 group by EDUCATIONTYPE ) t2 on t1.EDUCATIONTYPE=t2.EDUCATIONTYPE order by t1.EDUCATIONTYPE

select dic.DICKEY SHYKTYPE,dic.DICVALUE SHYKTYPENAME,ifnull(m.num,0) NUM from (select * from cf_dictionary where DICTYPEKEY='shykType' and OPERATESTATE <> 'D') dic left join ( select mt.SHYKTYPE,count(*) num from shyk_meeting m inner join shyk_meeting_type mt on m.meetingId = mt.meetingId where m.OPERATESTATE <> 'D' and mt.shykType in (1,2,3,4)
and m.PARTYCODE like concat('',#{dzzdm},'%')
group by mt.SHYKTYPE ) m on dic.DICKEY=m.SHYKTYPE order by dic.DICKEY

select t1.DZZDM,t1.DZZMC,ifnull(t1.CHILDCOUNT,0) as CHILDCOUNT,ifnull(t2.userCount,0) as USERCOUNT,ifnull(t3.meetingCount,0) as MEETINGCOUNT, ifnull(t4.XXCount,0) as CENTERCOUNT from (select distinct p.DZZDM,p.DZZMC,count(c.DZZDM) as CHILDCOUNT from (select dzzdm,dzzmc, zzlb from zz_zzqkxx where length(DZZDM)=12 and DZZDM like concat('',#{gddwdm},'%') p left join ZZ_ZZQKXX c on p.DZZDM=SUBSTR(c.DZZDM,1,12) --and length(c.DZZDM)>12 inner join ZZ_DZZFBQK zzfb on p.DZZDM=zzfb.DZZDM group by p.DZZDM,p.DZZMC ) t1 -- 党委信息 left join ( select SUBSTR(SZDZBDM,1,12) as DZZDM,count(u.RYBM) as userCount from vm_ryjbxx u group by SUBSTR(SZDZBDM,1,12) ) t2 on t1.DZZDM=t2.DZZDM -- 党员数量 left join ( select SUBSTR(PARTYCODE,1,12) as DZZDM,count(m.MEETINGID) as meetingCount from SHYK_MEETING m where 1=1 and OPERATESTATE <> 'D' and SHYKSTATUS not in (2) -- 排除已取消
and m.BEGINTIME >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
and m.ENDTIME < date_add(date_format(#{endTime},'%Y%m%d'),interval 1 day)
group by SUBSTR(PARTYCODE,1,12) ) t3 on t1.DZZDM=t3.DZZDM -- 三会一课数量 left join ( select SUBSTR(DW_ID,1,12) as DZZDM,count(ID) as XXCount from ZZ_ZXZXX_FA WHERE deleted <> 1 group by SUBSTR(DW_ID,1,12) ) t4 on t1.DZZDM=t4.DZZDM -- 中心组学习数量
left join ZZ_DZZFBQK fbType on t1.DZZDM = fbType.DZZDM where 1=1
and SUBSTR(t1.DZZDM,1,12) in(select DZZDM from ZZ_DZZFBQK where ZZFB= #{zzfbType})
order by fbType.SORT

SELECT t.ND,WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(t.JHFZDYSL) as JHFZDYSL, WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(t.GR) as GR, WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(t.SCGZDYX) SCGZDYX, WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(t.GTLY) GTLY, WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(t.XJMFRW) XJMFRW, WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(t.GZSQT) GZSQT, WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(t.GQTY) GQTY FROM DSJ_DYFZQK t where 1=1
and t.ND in
#{nd}
GROUP BY t.ND

select dickey as LEADERTYPE,t.LEADER_USER_ID,ifnull(t.count,0) as COUNT,ifnull(t.speaknumber,0) as SPEAKNUMBER from (select * from CF_DICTIONARY where DICTYPEKEY='zxzxxxxfaxxxs') d left join (select u.LEADER_USER_ID,f.study_modality_code,count(*) as count,sum(u.SPEAKNUMBER) as speaknumber from ZZ_ZXZXX_FA F inner join ZZ_ZXZXX_CJLDBZ u on f.ID=u.CASE_ID where 1=1 and f.DELETED = 0 and u.DELETED = 0 and u.LEADER_USER_ID=#{userCode} group by u.LEADER_USER_ID,f.STUDY_MODALITY_CODE ) t on d.DICKEY=t.STUDY_MODALITY_CODE order by DICKEY

select t.DZZDM,t.TOTAL,t.ZGCOUNT,fb.ZGRS,t.LTXCOUNT from ( select DZZDM,sum(total) TOTAL,sum(zgcount) ZGCOUNT,sum(ltxcount) LTXCOUNT from ( select substr(z.DZZDM, 1, length(#{dzzdm})) as DZZDM, count(1) as total, (sum(case when (us.GZGW not in('0500','0501','0502','0504') or us.GZGW is null) then 1 else 0 end)) zgcount, (sum(case when us.GZGW in('0500','0501','0502','0504') then 1 else 0 end)) as ltxcount from ZZ_ZZQKXX z left join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on z.DZZDM = fb.DZZDM inner join VM_RYJBXX us on z.DZZDM = us.SZDZBDM left join RS_RYJBXXFB usfb on us.RYBM = usfb.RYBM where z.DZZDM like concat('',#{dzzdm},'%') group by z.DZZDM ) t1 group by DZZDM ) t left join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on t.DZZDM = fb.DZZDM

select t1.FLOWTYPE ,ifnull(t2.num,0) NUM, (case when t1.FLOWTYPE=1 then '有' || ifnull(t2.num,0) || '名党员待谈话！' when t1.FLOWTYPE=2 then '有' || ifnull(t2.num,0) || '名入党积极分子待考察！' when t1.FLOWTYPE=3 then '有' || ifnull(t2.num,0) || '名预备党员待转正！' else '' end) as content, (case when t1.FLOWTYPE=1 then 1 when t1.FLOWTYPE=2 then 3 when t1.FLOWTYPE=3 then 22 else 0 end) as beginSort, (case when t1.FLOWTYPE=1 then 1 when t1.FLOWTYPE=2 then 5 when t1.FLOWTYPE=3 then 22 else 0 end) as endSort from (select dic.DICKEY as FLOWTYPE from cf_dictionary dic where dic.DICTYPEKEY='monthType' and dic.DICKEY <= 3) t1 left join (select FLOWTYPE,count(JOINUSERID) as num from ( select u.JOINUSERID, uf.SORT, ( case when uf.SORT =1 then 1 when uf.SORT >= 3 and uf.SORT <= 5 then 2 when uf.SORT >=22 and uf.SORT <= 22 then 3 else 0 end ) as FLOWTYPE from PE_JOINUSER u inner join VM_RYJBXX_ALL us on u.USERCODE=us.RYBM inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX z on us.SZDZBDM=z.DZZDM inner join ( select uf.JOINUSERID,max(f.SORT) SORT from PE_JOINUSER u inner join VM_RYJBXX_ALL us on u.USERCODE=us.RYBM inner join PE_JOINUSER_FLOW uf on u.JOINUSERID=uf.JOINUSERID inner join PE_FLOW f on uf.FLOWID = f.FLOWID where 1=1 and us.RYZT in('1','2','5','6')
and us.SZDZBDM like concat('',#{dzzdm},'%')
group by uf.JOINUSERID ) uf on u.JOINUSERID = uf.JOINUSERID ) tt1 group by FLOWTYPE
) t2 on t1.FLOWTYPE=t2.FLOWTYPE order by t1.FLOWTYPE

select dic.DICKEY as TYPE,dic.DICVALUE as NAME,count(1) as COUNT from DJ_BRAND kp inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on kp.PartyCode = zz.DZZDM inner join CF_DICTIONARY dic on kp.CREATTYPE = dic.DICKEY and dic.DICTYPEKEY='djBrand_creatType' where 1=1 and kp.OPERATESTATE <> 'D' group by dic.DICKEY,dic.DICVALUE order by DICKEY

/*select Extract(year from cf.APPROVALDATE) as year, sum(case when cf.PUNISHTYPE=1 then 1 else 0 end) as count1, sum(case when cf.PUNISHTYPE=2 then 1 else 0 end) as count2, sum(case when cf.PUNISHTYPE=3 then 1 else 0 end) as count3, sum(case when cf.PUNISHTYPE=4 then 1 else 0 end) as count4, sum(case when cf.PUNISHTYPE=5 then 1 else 0 end) as count5 from DJ_JLCFXX cf inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on cf.DZZDM = zz.DZZDM where 1=1 and cf.OPERATESTATE <> 'D' group by Extract(year from cf.APPROVALDATE) order by Extract(year from cf.APPROVALDATE)*/
select t.NAME, t.TYPE, t.YEAR,sum(case when cf.APPROVALDATE is not null then 1 else 0 end) as COUNT from ( select dic.DICVALUE as NAME,dic.DICKEY as TYPE,year.DICVALUE as YEAR from CF_DICTIONARY dic, CF_DICTIONARY YEAR where dic.DICTYPEKEY = 'punishType' and year.DICTYPEKEY = 'years' ) t left join ( select cf.PUNISHTYPE,cf.APPROVALDATE from DJ_JLCFXX cf inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on cf.DZZDM = zz.DZZDM where 1=1 and cf.OPERATESTATE <> 'D' ) cf on t.YEAR = Extract(year from cf.APPROVALDATE) and t.TYPE = cf.PUNISHTYPE where 1=1 group by t.NAME, t.TYPE, t.YEAR order by t.YEAR,t.TYPE, t.YEAR

select t.partyCode,t.partyName,fb.zzlb as partyType,t.userStatus,t.userStatusName ,sum(case when us.rybm is not null then 1 else 0 end) as userCount from ( select p.dzzdm as partyCode,p.dzzmc as partyName,t.bm as userStatus,t.hzmc as userStatusName from zz_zzqkxx p,zzzd_ryzt t ) t inner join zz_zzqkxxfb fb on t.partyCode = fb.dzzdm left join vm_ryjbxx_all us on substr(us.szdzbdm,1,length(t.partyCode)) = t.partyCode left join rs_ryjbxxfb usfb on us.rybm = usfb.rybm where 1=1 and (usfb.ISARCHIVE is null or usfb.ISARCHIVE = 0) group by t.partyCode,t.partyName,fb.zzlb,t.userStatus,t.userStatusName
select year(honourtime) as year,count(1) as count from dj_dnpxxx where pxlx=2 and OPERATESTATE <> 'D' group by year(honourtime)

select year(honourtime) as year , sum(case when HONOURTYPE=3 then 1 else 0 end) as count_partyUser , sum(case when HONOURTYPE=4 then 1 else 0 end) as count_workUser from dj_dnpxxx where pxlx=1 and OPERATESTATE <> 'D' group by year(honourtime)
select year(BRANDTIME) as year,count(1) as count from dj_brand where OPERATESTATE <> 'D' group by year(BRANDTIME)

select dic.DICKEY as typeValue,dic.DICVALUE as typeName,sum(case when prs.reportResult is null then 0 else 1 end) as count from CF_DICTIONARY dic left join pt_reportScore prs on prs.reportResult=dic.DICKEY left join pt_reportdata prd on prd.reportId = prs.reportId left join ZZ_ZZQKXX zz on prd.dzzdm = zz.DZZDM where dic.DICTYPEKEY='reportResult' group by dic.DICKEY,dic.DICVALUE order by dic.DICKEY
select year(CAREDATE) as year,count(1) as count from dj_dnghbfmx where 1=1 group by year(CAREDATE)
select month(ACTIVITYTIME) as month,count(1) as count from dj_ztdrxx where year(ACTIVITYTIME) = #{year} group by month(ACTIVITYTIME)
